payload.title: bridge_defect_claims never resolves the request's head commit in its workspace, so a head the workspace cannot read makes tier-0 reject every claim as claim_evidence_unresolved (the claim's fault) and the answer is recorded as one finished run and never bridged again
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/change_review.py:358-364 (the head is only checked to be non-empty text; it is never resolved against the workspace)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/change_review.py:290-308 (_screen_evidence: any TIER0_REJECT becomes REFUSED_UNRESOLVED; only an unanswered probe raises)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/tier0.py:271-279 (git show of target_sha:path exiting non-zero is an answer, so it is a reject cited_path_absent_at_target_sha)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/evidence_probe.py:220-266 (resolve_baseline separates BASELINE_UNREACHABLE from a real mismatch; the bridge never calls it)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/change_review.py:393-400 (the run is recorded once whatever was refused)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/pr_tracking.py:116-141 (the operator-subject mint resolves both ends with resolve_baseline and refuses by name)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/pr_tracking.py:416-418 (the merge feed mints with target_sha=offer.head_sha, the PR head, with no such resolution)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/change_review.py:377 (the bridge verifies in the store's bound workspace, which is not necessarily the workspace that minted the request)
payload.rule_violated: A refusal names the real cause (tri-state law of tier0 and evidence_probe: an unreadable baseline is not a verdict about the claim; change_review.py docstring: a probe that could not run is no verdict)
payload.notes: When target_sha names a commit the bridge's workspace does not hold (a merge-feed request carries the PR head sha, and the bridge verifies in the store's bound workspace, not necessarily the workspace that minted the request), git show answers non-zero and tier0_gate returns cited_path_absent_at_target_sha. Probed in a real repository with an unknown sha: tier0_gate rejects while GitProbeSession.resolve_baseline answers baseline_unreachable. Every claim of the answer is then written as a change_review_claim_refused row with reason claim_evidence_unresolved, one run is recorded with zero raw rows, and the answer is not bridged again, so a gap in the host's checkout is charged to the agent's claims and the hypotheses are lost. Close condition: In bridge_defect_claims resolve the head once through GitProbeSession.resolve_baseline before screening and raise GovernanceError (bridged again) when it is unreadable. Test: with a target_sha absent from the workspace the call raises, writes no change_review_claim_refused row and records no run, and a replay after the commit is present records the claims. Plan row: D3 (program finding ARIA-MEDIUM-761). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
